bennet_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_dialogue.text: Been a while since I've seen you Bennet, what are you having tonight?

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_dialogue.text: Yeah, it has. Just the usual please.

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_dialogue.text: Right away! How's the business going by the way?

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_dialogue.text: There isn't a lack of clients but my hands aren't as steady as they used to be, I'm going to have to close down the workshop im afraid.

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_dialogue.text: I'm quite sorry to hear that, who's gonna help me when I get locked out now?

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_dialogue.text: Oh I'm sure there's plenty of  reputable locksmiths around here Opal, I'm sure you'll find someone capable.

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_dialogue.text: I hope so sir. Have that last drink on the house, we're about to close out for the night.

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Bennet
bennet_dialogue.text: You have a nice night now.

bennet_dialogue.speaker: Opal
bennet_dialogue.text: You too, don't be a stranger and come around for a chat more often.
